description.text: Objectives This program is designed for international students with bachelor degree who wish to understand urban-rural planning and development issues in China. The program provides solid theory and technological knowledge to students who will be able to engage in project development and management in the areas of urban-rural planning and design. Duration Duration of the program is between 1.5 to 2 years. Research Areas 1. Urban Design Theory and Method 2. Urban-rural Planning Theory and Design Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 27 credits units. Of the 27 credits units required, 12 must be core courses, 10 must be elective courses, 3 must be thematic courses, and 2 must be practical courses. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The Urban-rural Planning at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
